observations.behavior: Adds a new shared-view restoration and deduplication mechanism. P1.F3.H4 replaces the previous shared-view restoration with a check that the current view still exists in the shared list, preventing restoration of deleted views. P1.F3.H6 adds a listener to restore a stored view only once, after the shared list has been refreshed, and only if the query is still the untouched default.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a user from accidentally switching to a shared view created by another user, or from switching to a shared view that has been deleted.
